mapper.select: SELECT ra.*, ca.id ca_id, ca.address_name ca_address_name, ca.`name` ca_name, ca.phone ca_phone, ca.province ca_province, ca.city ca_city, ca.region ca_region, ca.detail_address ca_detail_address FROM oms_order_return_apply ra LEFT JOIN oms_company_address ca ON ra.company_address_id = ca.id WHERE ra.id=#{id};
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oms_order_return_apply ( order_id, order_sn, create_time, member_username, return_amount, product_count, product_price, product_real_price, product_id, product_pic, product_name, product_brand, product_attr, status, reason, description, proof_pics, return_type, pre_status ) VALUES ( #{apply.orderId}, #{apply.orderSn}, now(), #{apply.memberUsername}, #{apply.returnAmount}, #{apply.productCount}, #{apply.productPrice}, #{apply.productRealPrice}, #{apply.productId}, #{apply.productPic}, #{apply.productName}, #{apply.productBrand}, #{apply.productAttr}, 0, #{apply.reason}, #{apply.description}, #{apply.proofPics}, #{apply.returnType}, #{apply.preStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE oms_order_return_apply SET status = #{status}, handle_man = #{handleMan}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, handle_time = now() WHERE id = #{id}
